# OMG BPMN 2.0.2 XML Schema bundle

These files are the normative machine-readable XML Schemas listed by the
Object Management Group for BPMN 2.0.2:

- Specification index: <https://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/2.0.2>
- Machine-readable index: <https://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/machine-readable>
- Source base: <https://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100501/>

The five XSD files were downloaded unchanged on 2026-08-09. They are kept
together because their imports/includes are relative, allowing the gateway to
compile and use the schema with network access disabled.
